encoding: years.png: R = year>>8, G = year&255 of the NEAREST footprint within reach_m (0 = none, or undated: never removed), B = height m*6 inside the exact footprint, A = 255. cover.png: signed distance to the nearest footprint edge in metres = (v/255-0.5)*sd_range_m, positive inside the footprint.

stats.note: The cadastre states a construction year; it is not proof of when a building was built (many old buildings carry rounded values). 768 of the dated buildings read exactly 1900.

source.name: Direccion General del Catastro, INSPIRE BuildingPart (saved copy 2026-11-21)

registration.method: In the browser: 22,801 vertical rays on a 2 m grid within 150 m of the data centre gave mesh heights; the Catastro footprint mask (and 2 m MDT02 terrain) was moved over them to maximise the correlation between (mesh height - terrain) and "inside a footprint".
registration.convention: grid = R(theta) * (east, north) + (tx, ty), grid in metres from the data centre, ENU in the local frame at (lat, lon) with y up, z south
registration.consistency: fits on the west/east/north/south halves agree: theta -0.4..-0.6, tx -1.5, ty -3.5..-4.0
registration.sensitivity: 1 m shift lowers the correlation by about 0.02
registration.geoid_note: ellipsoid height of bare ground = MDT02 height + 50.86 m (measured against the mesh, p25 of mesh-minus-terrain on open ground; spread about +-0.5 m)
